module: Computes the star time thresholds (gold, silver, bronze) of a rally special stage from a hand-made reference time (baseline) and the stage length. Gold = baseline x 1.03 (tight pace, no margin for resets). Silver and bronze = baseline x pace multiplier + an additive margin that forgives a certain number of resets per km.
usage:
local t = gameplay_rally_starThresholds.compute(600, 12.5)
-- t.gold, t.silver, t.bronze in seconds (rounded to the tenth)
notes: Formulas: gold = base*goldMult; silver = base*silverPaceMult + silverResetsPerKm*lengthKm*perResetSeconds; bronze = base*bronzePaceMult + bronzeResetsPerKm*lengthKm*perResetSeconds.
If the length is absent or zero, the reset margin is 0 (pace thresholds only).

silverResetsPerKm.desc: Resets per km forgiven for silver (0.9, i.e. ~2 resets on the shortest special stages of about 2.2 km).

bronzeResetsPerKm.desc: Resets per km forgiven for bronze (2.233, i.e. ~5 resets on the shortest special stages).

perResetSeconds.desc: Seconds added per reset in the margin: timer penalty (~5 s) plus loss of momentum (~3.5 s), i.e. 8.5.

compute.desc: Computes the gold/silver/bronze thresholds in seconds, rounded to the tenth.

baselineSeconds.desc: Stage reference time in seconds (converted by tonumber, 0 if invalid)

lengthKm.desc: Stage length in km (0 if invalid)
